pet_direwolf.name: Direwolf
pet_direwolf.description: A fierce crimson wolf born from fiery embers. Howls with burning courage.

pet_ember_pup.name: Ember Pup
pet_ember_pup.description: A playful fire hound that leaves smouldering footprints wherever it leaps.

pet_cinder_cub.name: Cinder Cub
pet_cinder_cub.description: Its warm fur crackles with sparks. Guards its master with fiery resolve.

pet_slime.name: Molten Slime
pet_slime.description: A bouncy glob of liquid magma that absorbs enemy blows.

pet_sprout.name: Flame Sprout
pet_sprout.description: A botanical marvel with petals forged of crimson embers.

pet_flame_sprite.name: Flame Sprite
pet_flame_sprite.description: Flutters like a living flame, dancing across battlefields.

pet_mossling.name: Mossling
pet_mossling.description: A gentle woodland dweller wrapped in velvet moss and morning dew.

pet_vine_pup.name: Vine Pup
pet_vine_pup.description: Tangles around your leg in joy. Shoots constricting vines at foes.

pet_thorn_whelp.name: Thorn Whelp
pet_thorn_whelp.description: A spiky dragonling whose thorny scales pierce aggressive enemies.

pet_grove_sprite.name: Grove Sprite
pet_grove_sprite.description: Harnesses natural restorative pollen to heal allies in dark ruins.

pet_slime_king.name: Verdant Slime King
pet_slime_king.description: Wears a small crown of acorns. Bounces with regal authority.

pet_forest_cub.name: Forest Cub
pet_forest_cub.description: Strong paws and a loyal heart rooted in the elder woods.

pet_frost_pup.name: Frost Pup
pet_frost_pup.description: Fur of powdered snow and eyes like frozen sapphires.

pet_ice_whelp.name: Ice Whelp
pet_ice_whelp.description: Breaths a fine mist of frost that slows charging predators.

pet_snow_cub.name: Snow Cub
pet_snow_cub.description: Born upon glacial peaks, impervious to winter chill.

pet_glacierling.name: Glacierling
pet_glacierling.description: A living chunk of ancient ice carved with runic markings.

pet_chill_sprite.name: Chill Sprite
pet_chill_sprite.description: Conjures cooling water bubbles that shield companions.

pet_frost_drake.name: Frost Drake
pet_frost_drake.description: Wings like sheets of glass. Swirls sub-zero winds in combat.

pet_stone_pup.name: Stone Pup
pet_stone_pup.description: A sturdy companion whose rocky tail thumps against the earth.

pet_rockling.name: Rockling
pet_rockling.description: A pebble-sized golem that hardens in the face of danger.

pet_boulder_cub.name: Boulder Cub
pet_boulder_cub.description: Heavier than it appears; crushes armor under heavy paws.

pet_crystal_sprite.name: Crystal Sprite
pet_crystal_sprite.description: Reflects cavern torchlight in dazzling geometric patterns.

pet_golem_whelp.name: Golem Whelp
pet_golem_whelp.description: An ancient construct infused with life by forgotten runes.

pet_granite_pup.name: Granite Pup
pet_granite_pup.description: Tough as a fortress bastion. Always ready to defend.

pet_storm_pup.name: Storm Pup
pet_storm_pup.description: Crackles with yellow static. Barks sound like tiny thunderclaps.

pet_thunder_cub.name: Thunder Cub
pet_thunder_cub.description: Moves with the swiftness of summer gale storms.

pet_lightning_drake.name: Lightning Drake
pet_lightning_drake.description: Arcs of current surge through its golden wings as it glides.

pet_wind_sprite.name: Wind Sprite
pet_wind_sprite.description: Whirls like a miniature cyclone, deflecting ranged missiles.

pet_gale_whelp.name: Gale Whelp
pet_gale_whelp.description: Swift as a thunderstorm gale. Unmatched agility.

pet_storm_hatchling.name: Storm Hatchling
pet_storm_hatchling.description: Spits crackling bolts of electricity at unwary adversaries.

pet_shadow_pup.name: Shadow Pup
pet_shadow_pup.description: Hides seamlessly within midnight shadows, watching loyally.

pet_voidling.name: Voidling
pet_voidling.description: An entity from beyond the veil. Glides without sound.

pet_dusk_whelp.name: Dusk Whelp
pet_dusk_whelp.description: Twilight scales shimmer between deep indigo and violet.

pet_night_cub.name: Night Cub
pet_night_cub.description: A nocturnal stalker with gleaming amethyst eyes.

pet_shade_sprite.name: Shade Sprite
pet_shade_sprite.description: Drains the light around it, granting stealth to its bearer.

pet_umbra_drake.name: Umbra Drake
pet_umbra_drake.description: Breathes smoky darkness that disorients dungeon beasts.

pet_crystal_drake.name: Crystal Drake
pet_crystal_drake.description: Its iridescent scales glow with pure refined arcana.

pet_arcane_pup.name: Arcane Pup
pet_arcane_pup.description: Channels mana pulses through its glowing cyan markings.

pet_mana_sprite.name: Mana Sprite
pet_mana_sprite.description: A floating celestial orb of living arcane knowledge.

pet_spell_whelp.name: Spell Whelp
pet_spell_whelp.description: Chants miniature incantations that empower magical spells.

pet_runeling.name: Runeling
pet_runeling.description: Ancient glyphs circle its miniature stone body in constant motion.

pet_crystal_hound.name: Crystal Hound
pet_crystal_hound.description: Hunts residual magical energy like a bloodhound of the arcane.

pet_void_pup.name: Nether Pup
pet_void_pup.description: Birthed from the darkest abyssal rifts. Feeds on enemy fear.

pet_abyssling.name: Abyssling
pet_abyssling.description: A writhing shadow of pure nether essence.

pet_nether_cub.name: Nether Cub
pet_nether_cub.description: Black fur absorbing all ambient torchlight.

pet_shadow_drake.name: Shadow Drake
pet_shadow_drake.description: Flies between dimensions, striking enemies from the blind spot.

pet_dark_hound.name: Dark Hound
pet_dark_hound.description: A terrifying guardian from the lower underworld.

pet_void_sprite.name: Void Sprite
pet_void_sprite.description: Punctures small tears in the fabric of space to confuse foes.

pet_phoenix_hatchling.name: Phoenix Hatchling
pet_phoenix_hatchling.description: The golden crest of eternal life. Rising from ashes in blinding brilliance.

pet_ember_drake.name: Ember Drake
pet_ember_drake.description: Scales of molten brass that radiate intense solar warmth.

pet_flame_hound.name: Flame Hound
pet_flame_hound.description: Breathes roaring bursts of fire upon wicked adversaries.

pet_inferno_pup.name: Inferno Pup
pet_inferno_pup.description: Full of boundless fiery enthusiasm, leaving trails of golden sparks.

pet_blaze_drake.name: Blaze Drake
pet_blaze_drake.description: Crown of radiant firehorns. A true scion of the Phoenix.

pet_phoenix_chick.name: Phoenix Chick
pet_phoenix_chick.description: Small golden feathers burning with the gentle warmth of rebirth.

pet_mythic_drake.name: Mythic Drake
pet_mythic_drake.description: Forged in the heart of celestial stars. Supreme sovereign of dragons.

pet_gold_pup.name: Gold Pup
pet_gold_pup.description: Its coat gleams like pure polished bullion. Brings fortune to its master.

pet_radiant_cub.name: Radiant Cub
pet_radiant_cub.description: Bathed in celestial dawn light, casting away all creeping shadows.

pet_divine_whelp.name: Divine Whelp
pet_divine_whelp.description: Possesses an aura of absolute majesty. Foes hesitate in its presence.

pet_light_sprite.name: Light Sprite
pet_light_sprite.description: An undying spark of creation itself. Elevates companions' spirits.

pet_mythic_hound.name: Mythic Hound
pet_mythic_hound.description: A celestial hound clad in golden plate armor. Unshakable vanguard.
